title: “Without AI and Robots, We’re Totally Screwed,” Elon Musk Warns on National Debt Crisis
key_facts: Musk spoke on the 5 Feb 2026 Dwarkesh Podcast with Dwarkesh Patel and Stripe's John Collison.
He said interest on the national debt exceeds the military budget, over a trillion dollars.
Quoted: 'Without AI and robots, nothing else will solve the national debt.'
BEA/FRED data: federal interest payments $1,279.7 billion vs national defence spending $949.0 billion in the quarterly reading cited.
Treasury fiscal 2025 interest was $970.1 billion, up 103.8% from $475.9 billion in fiscal 2022.
Total public debt was $39.46 trillion as of 1 Apr 2026.
The 10-year Treasury yield was 5.24% on 1 Oct and hit a 52-week high of 5.29% on 30 Sep.
quote_evidence: In the absence of AI and robotics, we're actually totally screwed because the national debt is piling up like crazy.
Without AI and robots, nothing else will solve the national debt.
why_it_matters_hint: Debt costs are rising; a claim that AI and robots can fix them is untested.
